title: Quiz challenge (Canvas)
description: A beat-the-clock quiz short built for a phone screen: 2-4 shared answers sit at the bottom as big labelled bins; each round the prompt slams in at full width over an empty answer slot, a big 3-2-1 counts down, then the right answer's colour floods the screen out of its bin, the answer fills the slot and a one-line reason or twist appears (option words in it get pills in their colours) before the colour wipes off. The outro recaps every answer, asks for the viewer's score, closes on a call to action and fades back into the opening frame so the short loops. Timed to a musical beat grid; works at any aspect ratio.

title.description: The challenge, shown big in the intro and small in the header (the hook)

kicker.description: One line under the hook in the intro; empty for none

options.description: The answers every round chooses from, left to right as bins

prompts.description: One prompt per round, shown full width; every prompt shares the size the longest needs

hints.description: Optional line under each prompt (a translation, a clue, which meaning is asked); one per prompt or none. Also shown in the recap

answers.description: The right option for each prompt; each must equal one of the options

notes.description: Optional one-line reason or twist shown on the reveal; words in it that equal an option get a pill in that option's colour ('die See = the sea'); one per prompt or none

outro.description: Outro heading that asks for the viewer's score

cta.description: Call to action in the closing pill

link.description: Optional short link under the call to action; empty for none

answer_style.description: How the recap reads: tag lists 'prompt · answer' (Mongolia · Asia); prefix puts the answer first (articles: 'das Mädchen'). In the rounds the answer always fills the slot above the prompt

recap.description: List every prompt with its answer in the outro

bpm.description: Beat grid: intro 3 beats, each round 6 beats (ticks at 0.75, 1.5, 2.25; reveal on 3; wipe off from 5.4), outro the rest (at least 2.5 s); match the music bed. A duration too short for the grid speeds it up, to at most a 0.32 s beat

palette.description: Ground, bin panel, ink and muted text

option_colors.description: One colour per option, in order (cycled when shorter); falls back to ink where it would not read

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`.
Uses the system's Inter (fonts-inter) when installed, else Helvetica Neue/Arial.
Throws when an answer is not one of the options, when hints or notes are given for only some prompts, or when the duration cannot hold 3 + 6N beats of at least 0.32 s plus a 2.5 s outro.
